'''Miho Hino''' (Japanese: '''日野未歩''' ''Hino Miho'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hino was born on February 4, 1982, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She provided her voice for [[Angie]], {{Ash}}'s friend from the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]], during {{aniseries|DP}}. Hino is affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
